content.title: AngloGold Ashanti Stock Glimmers In A Buy Zone After 108% Jump This Year
content.summary: Gold's run to record highs this year has supported AngloGold Ashanti stock, which has doubled in price, and shares are trading in a buy zone.  The miner's shares, which are on IBD's Big Cap 20 list, have surged about 108% this year.  This week, AngloGold Ashanti stock pushed further above its entry point in a six-week-long consolidation pattern.

content.title: AngloGold Ashanti Expands Nevada Presence Through Augusta Gold Deal
content.summary: On Wednesday, AngloGold Ashanti plc (NYSE:AU) announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Augusta Gold Corp. (OTC:AUGG) in an all-cash transaction with a total enterprise value of approximately 197 million Canadian dollars. The offer includes a purchase price of $1.70 Canadian dollars per share, implying an equity value of roughly 152 million Canadian dollars (approximately $111 million) and the repayment of shareholder loans totaling about 45 million Canadian dollars.
